notes.title: Feature Preview | Force-feedback
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/f91325100881f4c7791f6fdd005f423654ab294d.png[/img]

[h2]Hello Drivers![/h2]

[b]We are back![/b] We have been hard at work on the next update for Truck & Logistics Simulator. Today we wanted to share a major part of our next update, [b]force-feedback![/b] Force-feedback is something we heard could be improved, so we decided to make it a major part of our next update! Full and proper force-feedback is coming to PC and consoles! We have completely re-created our force-feedback system for all platforms, enabling us to expand the amount of features it has! Additionally we have a special opportunity for our PC players, see below. [b]Let's unpack![/b]

[list]
[*] First we have proper road force simulation. You can now feel the forces applying to steering axles, as well as feel the different road textures your vehicles drive over, such as on a cobblestone road or dirt!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/a7bd794c97f27edebe3894aa724c74a4246fb097.gif[/img]

[*] Collision forces are up next! We heard you wanted to feel something at each impact of your vehicle. Proper collision simulation was created, whether you hit head on, or from the side!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/9fa07d66a897c1a5e61eae30a61a3c94aa1cb48f.gif[/img]

[*] ABS and wheel traction forces are also now simulated! These forces help increase realism when driving, especially when braking or steering. With traction feel, you would be able to find the optimum steering point for best tire traction!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/b879279aff1e8a145acd19b1fdafc5b7e8af209b.gif[/img]

[*] Many more smaller forces have also been added, such as engine start, wheel push, and everything in between!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/c67ecb7675d33443289f91b974450da67af1fb7a.gif[/img]

Check out a video showcase of the highlighted features here: [previewyoutube=jp_u8jWRdxw;full][/previewyoutube]

[/list]
We are very pleased with the features we have been able to add to force-feedback for both PC and consoles. We are also working on fixes for wheels, especially Thrustmaster wheels force feedback issues! 
However there are a LOT of wheels out there and we want to make sure that these new features work on as many wheels as possible. [b]We need your help on PC to test wheels, see the details below![/b]

[h3]PC Force-feedback Feedback Beta:[/h3]

We only have a few wheels to test these new features on, so that is where you come in! If you play on PC and own any wheel that has force-feedback, from Hori and Logitech, to Thrustmaster, we would love to hear your feedback and assistance to iron out the kinks! If you are interested please [b][url=https://discord.gg/truck-logistics-simulator-669995447728996353]join our Discord server[/url][/b] and send a friend request to Meceka [SimulaGames] or Michael [Community Manager]. We look forward to hearing from you!

You can find the development patch notes for the next update here: [url=https://trello.com/c/iJJTx7iC/191-click-here-for-change-log]Trello - Change Log [/url]

Stay tuned, and see you on the road!

[i]Michael | Community Manager[/i]

[b][url=https://discord.gg/truck-logistics-simulator-669995447728996353]Join us on Discord![/url][/b]

notes.title: The Enhanced Driving Update is out NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/93e21c88d437a1527feddfc67cdc470b6ac04e47.jpg[/img]

[h3]The Enhanced Driving Update is live NOW on PC and Consoles![/h3]

[b]Core Update Changes: [/b]
[list]
[*] Brake Overheat Simulation
[*] Vehicle Paint/Lighting/Physics Overhaul
[*] Manual Transmission for Controllers
[*] Remodeled Wheels & Truck Exteriors 
[*] Vastly Improved Multiplayer Synchronization
[*] New Dynamic Camera
[*] Smarter Recovery System
[*] Bug Fixes & Optimization
[/list]
[h3]Watch the Enhanced Driving Update trailer here:[/h3] [previewyoutube=HrgsW4AOlow;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Check Out Our Enhanced Vehicles![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/8b2bcf927ef207d1e6e7fe367d8e524dc800653f.png[/img]

[h3]New clean looks![/h3] We dedicated a lot of time to increasing the quality of our vehicles. Vehicle paint has been remade with better lighting, reflections, and looks. Almost every vehicle and trailer has brand new wheels with unique designs and brakes! More wheel damage has also been added, where hub-caps of some vehicles will pop off. Heavy truck trailer now have a king pin for trailer connections to add to the visual realism. New mirrors, door handles, and more details have been added to our MAN and Scania trucks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/aaad7eebf0484e243815651777592367efa85dc4.gif[/img]

[h3]Let there be light![/h3] Our MAN and Scania truck's headlights have been completely remade in 3D! All vehicle headlights have been remade to now have daytime driving lights for better visibility on the road. All vehicle and trailer brake/reverse lights now light up the environment. Trucks and trailers have received more marker lights for brighter and cleaner looks. We hope you love the new looks of our vehicles and trailers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/47c4a475893a4e71724c09ea7a939aba3a8d67ab.gif[/img]

[h3]Have more control over YOUR vehicles![/h3] Brake overheat simulation has been added to all vehicles and trailers. Brakes are fully simulated with proper calculations for heat. When your brakes overheat, you will experience a loss in braking power and control!
We heard our community LOUD and CLEAR. Manual transmission is now supported on controllers, giving you a new layer of control. With a complete remake of vehicle wheel colliders, you'll experience more immersive and realistic physics with accurate suspension inertia and more.  
The camera systems for both the interior and exterior have been remade. Using the acceleration of the vehicle, road forces, and impacts, it properly offsets & rotates the camera, giving a better feeling of physics and movement. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/1ff64fb32e9bbb72a54260582e4adc91c1cff7ae.gif[/img]

[h2]Enhancing Your Quality of Life![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/c2790ba44da8f791326a46a487bc739e72c79046.png[/img]

[h3]Better connecting you with your friends![/h3] We have completely rewritten the code that handles multiplayer position tracking and synchronization. No longer should you see other players stopping and freezing due to latency and ping. Additionally other players should now move more fluently on the road especially when at high speeds. Thanks to the brand new daytime lights for vehicles and new marker lights for trailers, it is now much easier to see and be seen on the road!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/15037d66cbf394500866e06697b47112c5f2b3b6.gif[/img]

[h3]A faster and smoother experience![/h3] We dedicated a lot of time to optimizing the game for a better all-around experience. The reflection and mirror system for vehicles and the environment has been completely rewritten to enhance performance on all platforms. Vegetation loading stuttering has been reduced, and lighting and reflections on car surfaces and interiors have been optimized. Console render distances for reflections and mirrors have been improved, especially for lower graphic settings. Additionally, shadows have been significantly optimized and their quality enhanced. Finally we improved the UI and vehicle recovery systems to improve the overall experience for everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/0af2a3e0113588e046570ddabc693ce238f22b19.png[/img]

[h2]Our Efforts to the Community![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/cfa7ce2d565f7a4822a2fe4d0c43995c176ff93e.png[/img]

[h3]Your feedback has been invaluable![/h3] Your feedback after release was amazing, and it has helped us has shaped this update to be what it is. We listen to each and every comment you all leave both here, on Discord, and our other socials! We want to thank all of you for influencing the development of this update. So many changes were added by request of YOU!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/e41e38c4ab3f527f08bbc90587f572afb9f927f0.png[/img]

[h3]Bugs be GONE![/h3] This update has by far the most amount of bug fixes to date and we could not have fixed all of them without you! Thank you for reporting issues and bugs to us and being patient with us as we fix them! Check out the full change-log to see just a small handful of the issues we have fixed thanks to YOU.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/d4e4bc25ee13f7cce5dc7c1a06e3c65c3d14e663.png[/img]

[b]You can find the patch notes for the update here: [url=https://trello.com/c/vD2I7eER/255-update-102-click-for-change-log]Trello - Change Log [/url][/b]

See you on the road!
[i]Your Truck & Logistics Simulator Team[/i]

notes.title: Truck & Logistics Simulator | Feature Preview 6
notes.content:
[b]Hello Drivers![/b]

Today we wanted to share our final [b]Feature Preview[/b] on Update 1.02 or the “Enhanced Driving Update”! The focus of today's shorter preview is to show off the brand new truck exteriors and new trailer lighting! [b]Finally we are thrilled to announce that we will be sharing the release date for the update very soon![/b] [b]Let's unpack![/b]

[list]
[*] We heard you, some of our vehicle models, especially trucks needed some attention. After we completed work on remaking all of the vehicle wheels, we set our eyes on enhancing the overall quality of our Scania and MAN trucks! After all, those are the player favorites. These trucks have gotten redesigned exteriors with new 3D headlights, new mirrors, door handles, bigger navigation displays, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/f5c5121081c545f1d5e5831ad32b3a38d2575b22.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/0f3a2dc4b9dcabb22993e054e20bf403747342fc.gif[/img]


[*] Vehicles are not the only thing to get some remodeling! We spent some time rethinking lighting patterns and enhancing the quality of our heavy truck trailers. All trailers now have more, brighter marker lights increasing its visibility on the road. It is now easier to see and be seen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/b7f18c150e62f18e39b495b68283e46da919f955.gif[/img]

[*] The update was envisioned differently when we first announced our work had started. We took a long look at the feedback we received from our community and kept adapting and adding to our list of items to get done. This is in conjunction with our efforts to deliver major updates that have a lot of content rather than smaller ones that are not substantial. We would like to thank our community for their continued patience with us. [b]The update has been submitted for testing and certification and we will announce the release date next week! [/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/60f83a2b71b16303133af07558e2599464e64c0c.png[/img]

Check out a video showcase of the highlighted features here: [previewyoutube=K9Wni_yl5lg;full][/previewyoutube]

[/list]

Well that's it from me! We hope you are looking forward to the full announcement of the Enhanced Driving Update soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/d4e4bc25ee13f7cce5dc7c1a06e3c65c3d14e663.png[/img]

You can find the development patch notes for the update here: [url=https://trello.com/c/vD2I7eER/255-update-102-click-for-change-log]Trello - Change Log [/url]

Stay tuned, and see you on the road!

notes.title: Truck & Logistics Simulator | Feature Preview 5
notes.content:
[b]Hello Drivers!
[/b]
It has been a little bit, but we are back! Welcome to our fifth [b]Feature Preview[/b]! The focus of today's preview is looking at the brand new vehicle wheels and showing off the brand new brake overheat simulation! Additionally we want to talk a bit about the final items we are completing before release, it is coming very soon! [b]Lets unpack!![/b]

[list]
[*] We have been hard at work on vehicle exterior redesigns! What better way to start it off then to show the band new wheels for vehicles & trailers. These new wheels not only look shiny and sleek, but are crucial for the new [b]brake overheat simulation[/b]! 
Wheel colliders are now much more realistic for better physics immersion. Additionally with the new wheels brings new damage! Be careful and make sure to drive carefully or some of your vehicle might pop off!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/85611f23f97a3c529fcc80d787167e56b79c1291.gif[/img]

[*] Brake overheat simulation is here! Vehicles and trailers now have proper brake simulation allowing brakes to overheat and affect vehicle physics! We tried to make this feature simulate as close to reality as possible! As you slam on your brakes down a hill, be careful to not overheat the brakes and lose braking power. Up to 75% of braking power can be lost due to overheating. Along with our physics improvements shown before, we are very happy with the new levels of realism we have created for our vehicles! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/d37be35bcf93ea7e101143a60f8647f443d9c509.gif[/img]

[*] Trailers have gotten all the same treatment with brand new wheels and brake overheat simulation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/e34b6f07a3827b8c3b3e2bfe2a788b8c5c450d2c.gif[/img]

[*] Update 1.02 is nearing completion! We will have one final Feature Preview for Update 1.02. Currently we are working on re-modeling some of our truck exteriors and remaking some of our lighting patterns for heavy truck trailers. We look forward to showing those off to you soon! Here is a small teaser of our improved Man model!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/2a925d7921f3699681a534379573f1210574930a.jpg[/img]

Check out a video showcase of the highlighted features here: [previewyoutube=pgAnrguMZcc;full][/previewyoutube]

[/list]
Well that's it from me! We will be back again soon with Feature Preview 6!

Update 1.02 is in full active development and will arrive very soon. You can find the work-in-progress patch notes for update 1.02 here: [url=https://trello.com/c/vD2I7eER/255-update-102-click-for-change-log]Trello - Change Log [/url]

Stay tuned, and see you on the road!

[i]Your Truck & Logistics Simulator Team[/i]
Mehmet, Sumeyye, Osman, Gustavo, Olena, and Michael

[b][url=https://discord.gg/truck-logistics-simulator-669995447728996353]Join us on Discord![/url][/b]

notes.title: Truck & Logistics Simulator | Feature Preview 4
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Welcome to our fourth [b]Feature Preview[/b]! The focus of today's preview is showing off enhancements we have made to the camera system and car paint! Additionally we want to talk a bit about bugs and we will show a small look at DLC Pack 1! [b]Lets dig in![/b]

[list]
[*] Since launch the camera has always felt a little stiff. With update 1.02 we have completely rebuilt the camera system to feel more realistic and give better movement! The exterior camera now takes your vehicles acceleration, position, and road forces to offset and rotate the camera. This gives the exterior camera a better feeling of physics and movement!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/eeca6c8af71c29f37b257003f68a7a55ab647a0f.gif[/img]

[*] The interior camera now has dynamic movement! The camera will push back based on acceleration or sudden movement. Now you will feel every crash and jolt!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/b3e0b696de8aadc08eebc2d2c38a275c66754f5b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/f8bb9e8bcb6c828843afa6105b4851f6d1091272.gif[/img]

[*] Vehicles have gotten a new paintbrush! Paint is now much more detailed, brighter, and more reflective. Especially with the upcoming SuperCar, you will be driving in sleek clean style! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/509dd0809ccd1b5dcb4064142faf51374e05f7b2.png[/img]

[*] For those of you with a high end PC, reflection quality has received a massive upgrade! Higher quality reflections on vehicles are now possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/8a7017733cbf49acd7055890cd9226b01c189f74.png[/img]

[*] We wanted to talk a bit about bugs. We have tried our best to deliver a fully playable and polished game. However some issues can still arise even after testing. We first want to thank everyone for reporting issues to us! Without your help, a lot of bugs can go unnoticed on our end! With update 1.02 we are delivering a bunch of bug fixes! Numerous crashes, mission issues, and environment issues have been fixed! A lot of these were fixed thanks to YOUR reports! Please continue to report bugs to us over Discord!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/27a9dafdcf4e1b7e4900cd50eb5a5f696e2aa1b7.png[/img]

[*] We are wrapping up our Feature Previews for update 1.02! We plan to have one more Feature Preview for Update 1.02 before we move onto DLC Pack 1! We hope you enjoy this small teaser of one of the new things coming with the DLC:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/b4f7acfd5c7093b4aa224bbf5cfb900e20080c90.gif[/img]

[/list]
Update 1.02 is in full active development and will arrive with the release of DLC Pack 1. You can find the work-in-progress patch notes for update 1.02 here: [url=https://trello.com/c/vD2I7eER/255-update-102-click-for-change-log]Trello - Change Log [/url]

Check out a video showcase of the highlighted features here: [previewyoutube=pgAnrguMZcc;full][/previewyoutube]

Stay tuned, and see you on the road!
[i]Michael | Community Manager[/i]

[b][url=https://discord.gg/truck-logistics-simulator-669995447728996353]Join us on Discord![/url][/b]

notes.title: Truck & Logistics Simulator | Feature Preview 3
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Welcome to our third Feature Preview! The focus of today's preview is showing off enhancements we have made to the game with update 1.02!

[list]
[*] We heard you LOUD and CLEAR! One of our biggest requests since release was adding native support for manual transmission for controllers. You can now manually shift on any controller! Xbox: While holding RB, press A/B to shift. Playstation: While holding R1, press O/X to shift!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/9d38cc3a77c7939ae4cd048287d86794b409ca65.gif[/img]

[*] A lot of work has gone into multiplayer synchronization. We have vastly improved position tracking of other players and reduced de-sync causing other players to freeze. Additionally players moving at high speeds will now move more fluently on the road!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/9f81ac283a000236c1b31846101a1af6b9138310.gif[/img]

[*] Heavy trailers now have a Kingpin for connection. Not only does this add to the visual realism, this also helps to assist bugs with trailer connections!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/01d9534fbb7aa3e2c3c586133ae19377b972d042.gif[/img]

[*] Finally, the vehicle recovery system has also received enhancements! When a re-spawn point is invalid, it will skip it and try to locate another point to re-spawn, you no longer will re-spawning on the same point!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/5282f2ecb058f26ee86d872f27326786026a45ed.gif[/img]
[/list]

Update 1.02 is in full active development and will arrive with the release of DLC Pack 1. You can find the work-in-progress patch notes for update 1.02 here: 
[b][url=https://trello.com/c/vD2I7eER/255-update-12-click-for-change-log]Trello Roadmap - 1.02 Changelog[/url][/b]

The next Feature Preview is still TBD, but we plan to showcase some brand new enhancements to the camera system, new car paint, and brake pad simulation.

Check out a video of the highlighted features here: [previewyoutube=aaIjhZV6rCQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Stay tuned, and see you on the road!
[i]Michael | Community Manager [/i]

[b][url=https://discord.gg/truck-logistics-simulator-669995447728996353]Join us on Discord![/url][/b]

notes.title: Truck & Logistics Simulator | Feature Preview 2
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

Welcome to our second Feature Preview! The focus of today's preview is showing off changes to vehicle  lighting in update 1.02!

[list]
[*]First we are happy to showcase a major request from the community! With update 1.02, all vehicle and trailer reverse/brake lights now dynamically illuminate the environment! Making reversing into parking spots and navigating in the night much easier!

notes.title: A dev-blog about progress with the biggest update so far.
notes.content:
[h3]Convoy Escort in Multiplayer[/h3]
Convoy escort missions are almost completed. All vans, pickups, and cars will have purchasable convoy equipment which will allow you to escort logistics convoys in multiplayer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/abfd48116f2bc485498be5458c7b0f584e48464f.png[/img]

[h3]Map Extension[/h3]
A new 8 square-kilometer region will be added to the map in this update which will extend the mission length, allow longer duration missions, and will also provide alternative routes with mountain roads. The map extension is 90% completed but currently has many issues that we are currently working on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/5f78a484a38264e6ddac2430704dbeaa7eea02eb.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Missions[/h3]
Here are screenshots of some of the new missions that are currently in testing;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/11852374aada9bcbfd012cf90a169adcedb40b4a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/98680ab01333b45b284c31930c9b7351db854eeb.gif[/img]

[h3]Vehicles[/h3]
There are more new vehicles than what we announced earlier. We added 6x4 versions of the trucks and remodeled around 50% of their exteriors. 

We added a new modern truck which is still in integration. We added towing capacity to vehicles that vary between models and some vehicles can’t support heavier cargo missions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/d16ecf1469acdca80bc5e4f44513cef58bd834d5.jpg[/img]

A new minivan is also completed and integrated into the game. There are many new cargoes like a camping caravan or a generator.

There are many other small features like Cruise Control support and improvements in the environment with moving ships or aircraft. There are many UI improvements including the ability to navigate to any point on the map using the mid-mouse click or seeing which missions a vehicle can support.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/a1221675751203c4cad03520fac11d67340e1959.jpg[/img]

We also improved vehicle physics by improved collision meshes of all vehicles and better brake handling for trailers.

[h3]Test Drive[/h3]
We added a “Test Drive” function to vehicles before you purchase them. This feature allows you to test any mission available in the game without owning the vehicle similar to a sandbox mode.

[h3]Future plans[/h3]
For the future, company management is a major feature that is currently in development. You will be able to create a company with a name and a logo and hire AI drivers for this company.
You will also be able to purchase vehicles and assign them to AI drivers, based on their experience and driving licences. Each AI driver and also your own driver profile will improve and level up after completing logistics missions and you will choose which licences to progress first. 

The company management and driver profile features will probably be released with the version in which we get out of early access and make the full release of the game. We can't tell when exactly that will be. However, we want to share our plans with you already. 

The big update with the map extension, the new missions etc. will be coming soon.

To follow the latest news, join our Discord server:
https://discord.gg/PCjxFjs

Vehicles

* Added interior seat position option for Up-Down.

* Significantly improved reflections and night lighting.

* Improved lighting and shadows.
* Added clouds to mirror reflections.

Environment
* Added old towns to the existing map with narrow roads.
* Many new mountain roads.
* New European style traffic lights and traffic signs.
* Increased the visual clarity of the terrain.
* Reduced bumpiness and improved the curve on some roads.

Traffic

* Added "Traffic Density Slider"

Audio

User Interface

* User Interface (UI) mirror setting is now persistent.
* Recreated the vehicle images in the UI with better contrast.

Multiplayer
* Traffic lights are now synchronized in multiplayer.
* Added an option in the multiplayer player list to disable collisions with all players.
* Trailers turn signals, reverse and etc. are now also synchronized.

Bug Fixes
* Improvements and bug fixes to manual gear shifting and H-Shifter support.
* When recovering your vehicle or restarting a mission now the game disables collisions to avoid glitches in multiplayer.

Other
*Fullscreen is extended with more options. In the screen resolutions, refresh rate is also selectable.

notes.title: A quick update about the development!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/0fdd18f4af890457331328d37f90e3ada28b0e9d.jpg[/img]
Here is a quick update about the development!

The new minivan is about 90% complete. The team has been working on improving the map, starting with the map extension, new traffic signs, new European style traffic lights, a new mission, and so on.

But the work-in-progress graphics optimization caused a big delay in updates. This required a major rewrite in the code and that caused lots of new bugs and instability. We're hoping to see it completed next week and then we can release an update.

Development of the company management feature has started. It will take about 6 months of time to develop.

These are the current changelog for the next update. More might be added and we will make a separate announcement when update is ready. Not yet released, planning to release in a week:

[list][*]Separated Graphics Settings to allow better customization and optimization. (Shadow Quality, motion blur and etc.)
[*]New European style traffic signs.
[*]Improved wheel and rim models of most of the vehicles.
[*]When recovering your vehicle or restarting a mission now the game disables collisions temporarily to avoid collisions in multiplayer.
[*]User Interface (UI) mirror setting is now persistent.
[*]Added interior seat position option for Up-Down. (Was only forward-back)
[*]Added Frame Rate Limit (Max FPS) to graphics options.
[*]Recreated the vehicle images in the UI.
[*]Added physically responsive axle models to some vehicles.
[*]Increased fuel consumption of vehicles.
[*]Disabled audio in the pause menu.
[*]Improvements and bug fixes to manual gear shifting and H-Shifter support.
[*]Many fixes with the map. Reduced bumpiness and improved the curve on some roads.
[*]User interface improvements.[/list]
[i]This isn't the big update that includes a new minivan, rain and more. That big update is planned to be released in 3 weeks we will announce it closer to release. It will also be released on Nintendo Switch at the same time.[/i]

[i]Your Truck & Logistics team[/i]

notes.title: Truck and Logistics Simulator | Update v0.9646
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/1b5b1f48d4e18a9a21bea35b9c74145646293a40.png[/img]
[h3]Third update is available now, here is the full changelog:[/h3]
[list][*]Optimized performance of shadows.
[*]Optimized memory usage and reduced map loading times.
[*]Improved performance for old graphics cards that don't support compute shaders.
[*]Added V-Sync toggle in options.
[*]Zooming out the minimap now works and it can be resized bigger.
[*]Time of day slider settings(timescale, system time/simulated/none) are now saved.
[*]Increased camera rotation speeds with controllers.
[*]Fixed keyboard binding of wipers and hazard lights.
[*]Fixed light brightness of tandem box trailer.
[*]The game now auto hides cursor when driving a loader with the right mouse button.
[*]Fixed issue with street light brightness at night.
[*]Fixed lighting of the lake material.
[*]Disabled rain temporarily as it's still WIP and isn't supposed to be visible.
[*]Improved environment and vegetation
[/list]

[i]Your Truck & Logistics team[/i]
